hits.snippet:
## Other trends across the quarter

### Complaints about car or motorcycle insurance

Car and motorcycle insurance complaints rose to 4,100, up from 2,800 in the same period in 2025, with consumers raising concerns about claim values, policy cancellations and claim delays.

Download the data: New complaints about car or motorcycle insurance (XLSX 9KB)

### Travel insurance [...] Travel insurance complaints also rose by 30% (300) year-on-year to 1,300 cases, and up slightly on the previous quarter where we received 1,200 complaints about this product. The most common complaint issue was declined claims.

hits.title: Complaints data | FCA
hits.snippet:
# Complaints data

Transparency from firms on the number of complaints they receive is helpful for industry and consumers. Firms can compare their performance in the market and consumers have an additional source of information about the firms we regulate. Further complaints data may be obtained from the Financial Ombudsman Service.

15 May 2026 update

Following our investigation into a reporting anomaly in one firm’s complaints return, we have updated the H1 2025 and H2 2025 data. [...] Firm-specific data relating to Consumer credit complaints can be found on the Firm-level sortable tables under the 'Consumer credit' tab.

More information on how to use our complaints data.

## Making a complaint

If you are unhappy with a financial product or service received, please see how to complain.

## Future edition publication dates

H1 2026 data: 22 October 2026

H2 2026 data: 29 April 2027

View previous versions of the complaints data

## In this section

## Data [...] Firm specific complaints data

Our firm-specific complaints data set is composed of submissions from approximately 290 individual firms reporting either 500 or more complaints within a 6-month period, or 1,000 or more complaints annually. The data is available in 2 formats via 8 sortable tables that can be searched and filtered on at firm-level and a downloadable Excel file that can be filtered by 5 product groups.

hits.title: Annual complaints data and insight 2023/24 – Financial Ombudsman service
hits.snippet:
Complaints about insurance are up by 18% overall compared to 2022/23. Car/motorcycle complaints have increased by 38% to 16,322 when compared to last year’s annual data. The uphold rate has also increased for this product, from 30% in 2022/23 to 38% in 2023/24. [...] The total number of new complaints we received about banking and payments has reached the highest-level in at least a decade. The last time we saw a peak in banking complaints was in 2015/16 because of packaged bank accounts.

This is a rise from levels the previous year (2022/23) when there were 61,995 complaints and is largely due to concerns about current accounts and credit cards, as well as complaints about fraud and scams. [...] Overall, we received 198,798 new complaints in 2023/24 compared with 165,149 the previous year.
 Complaints about current accounts, credit cards and fraud and scam have driven a significant increase in banking and payment complaints.
 The most complained about product was current accounts.
 On average, across all financial products, the Financial Ombudsman Service upheld 37% of the complaints it resolved, which is slightly higher than the 35% recorded in 2022/23.

hits.title: Annual complaints data and insight 2024/25 – Financial Ombudsman service
hits.snippet:
We saw significant rises across most of the main product complaint areas – with some issues and products at their highest ever recorded level. This includes complaints about motor finance commission, fraud and scams and credit cards.

Overall this year, we received 305,726 complaints about financial products. The last time we received more complaints was in 2018/19, when we received 388,392 complaints. [...] Overall, we received 305,726 new complaints in 2024/25, the highest level of complaints for six years.
 This is a 54% increase when compared to the 198,798 complaints reported in the previous year.
 Complaints saw significant rises, with complaints about some issues and products at their highest ever recorded level.
 The most complained about product was Hire Purchase (motor)
